evidence: enterDailyDouble (engine.go:1254-1276) builds ratingPool from online mobilePlayers (excluding performer) and finishes only via onRate (engine.go:1298-1301): `if len(e.ratings) >= len(e.ratingPool) { e.finishDailyDouble() }` — the ONLY caller of finishDailyDouble. OnDisconnect (engine.go:425-442) on a full disconnect does `delete(e.ratingPool, playerID)` then re-evaluates completion ONLY for `if e.state == protocol.StateKaraoke { e.evaluateSkipVotes() }` — never for StateDailyDouble, never calls finishDailyDouble. Same gap in onAdminKick (engine.go:1360-1382): deletes from ratingPool but only re-checks `if e.state == protocol.StateKaraoke`. Trace: pool={A,B}; A rates -> ratings={A}, 1>=2 false, no finish; B disconnects -> pool={A}, state==DailyDouble so skip-vote branch not taken, finishDailyDouble never re-invoked -> now len(ratings)==1==len(ratingPool) but nothing re-checks it. Stuck in DAILY_DOUBLE. No timeout rescues it: only timers are telemetryTicker (60s, telemetry only), reveal ticker/AfterFunc chain, and scheduleAutoKaraoke (engine.go:1734) which advances ONLY from StateRoundActive/StateLocked, never StateDailyDouble. No admin command force-advances DailyDouble (dispatchAdmin engine.go:486-506: grade/select/playback/award/kick/reveal/endRound/endGame — endRound/endGame are the only manual escapes). Hostile mobile that never sends 'rate' also hangs indefinitely (no per-phase timeout). Confirmed by code trace; not run as test.
fix: Extract the completion check into a helper e.checkDailyDoubleComplete() { if e.state==StateDailyDouble && len(e.ratings) >= len(e.ratingPool) { e.finishDailyDouble() } } and call it from onRate, and from OnDisconnect + onAdminKick after the ratingPool delete (add a StateDailyDouble branch alongside the existing StateKaraoke evaluateSkipVotes branch). Guard len(ratingPool)==0 -> enterKaraoke to avoid finishing an empty pool. Optionally add a daily-double timeout via time.AfterFunc keyed on roundKey to defend against hostile mobiles that never rate.
